description: This file defines a Pinia store for managing shopping cart state in a frontend Vue.js application. It includes state definitions, getters for computed properties, actions to modify cart items, and storage interactions.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart, updating quantity if it already exists, and shows a success notification.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart by product ID and shows a success notification.

methods.name: updateQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a product in the cart or removes it if the quantity is zero or less.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart and shows a success notification.

methods.name: isInCart
methods.description: Checks if a product is in the cart by product ID.

methods.name: getItemQuantity
methods.description: Retrieves the quantity of a specific product in the cart.

methods.name: saveToStorage
methods.description: Saves current cart items to local storage if running on client.

methods.name: loadFromStorage
methods.description: Loads cart items from local storage on client side.
